crossRefs.note: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.
As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out…
lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in the prison; for he was in a rage with him because of this thing. Asa…
The Spirit of God came on Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them…
They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of Yahweh’s house.
The princes were angry with Jeremiah, and struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe; for…
When Jeremiah had come into the dungeon house, and into the cells, and Jeremiah had remained there many days,
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…
But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
“He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’”
who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all…
forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them…

translations.web: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.
translations.bsb: On hearing this, all the people in the synagogue were enraged.
translations.kjv: And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath,
translations.asv: And they were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things;
